verdict.summary_en: Korean delivery note DN-261023-398 dated 2026.10.23 from Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg, against PO 4500318707. One line: CMP-GAM-001 Game Card 128 GB – Grand Heist 6, 68 000 PCS in 13 boxes, 117 kg, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. Remark: handle with care. Stamped received 27.10.2026 at DC-HAM and signed by 'Schulz P.'. No corrections or discrepancies are visible. The note carries no ordered quantity, so it can't be compared with the PO from this document alone.
observations: Red circular company stamp 'HWASEONG MEMORY CO LTD' overlaps the unit (단위) header, the 'PCS' cell and the box count '13'; the values are still readable.
Blue rectangular stamp 'RECEIVED 27.10.2026 DC-HAM' is legible.
Handwritten receiver name/signature 'Schulz P.' in blue ink above the 인수자 (receiver) line.
Quantity is printed with a space as the thousands separator ('68 000').
No handwritten corrections or strike-throughs. The lower half of the page is blank.
